scope: Engage from a docked encounter continues the original paid journey
behavior: Controller displays the original journey destination and departure preview while docked at the encounter. Engage accepts a completed docking course, undocks, resumes without another jump fee and arrives at the original destination. A different explicitly selected destination is preserved. Legacy journeys without saved selection fall back to their paid destination region.

native.coverage: Real FTL/boarding handshakes, docking, cargo collection, return boarding, controller destination/readiness preview, one Engage packet, automatic undock/resume/arrival, no second jump fee, depleted cargo preserved
native.fixture: Uses the original deterministic clear approach position so randomized encounter routing does not confound this departure regression.

qualification: Only affected checks run; full batch integration remains pending.
